evidence_boundary: Retrospective diagnostic/sensitivity analysis of previously inspected outer labels; not a new blind test or repair validation.
outlier_rule: absolute error > Q3 + 1.5 IQR within context/model
label_use: Evaluator-only descriptive error and regret; no training, calibration, feature engineering, tuning, or repair selection.
local_export: Aggregates only; no sequence strings or sequence-level measured labels.
